entries.speaker: Adrien
entries.raw: je vais creer une entreprise agence marketing et service pour les entreprises european qui veulent aller en chine pour les expositions, je peux contacter les constructeurs pour les constructions de stands
entries.normalized_business_meaning: Initial brief: marketing/service agency for European companies entering China for exhibitions, including stand-builder coordination.

entries.speaker: Adrien
entries.raw: je voulais faire une agence dr marketing, ecommerce, et tradeshows
entries.normalized_business_meaning: Core business pillars: marketing, e-commerce and trade shows.

entries.speaker: Adrien
entries.raw: avenzo studio
entries.normalized_business_meaning: Brand name selected: Avenzo Studio.

entries.speaker: Adrien
entries.raw: J’ai finalisé le texte
entries.normalized_business_meaning: Business copy was considered finalized in the supplied Avenzo Studio document.

entries.speaker: Adrien
entries.raw: je dis le site, le texte n'a été pas changé bb
entries.normalized_business_meaning: The supplied document text must actually be reflected in the website; visual changes must not leave stale copy.

entries.speaker: Adrien
entries.raw: le site manque de design en fait, je voulais des bandeaux
entries.normalized_business_meaning: Use stronger banner-led visual composition.

entries.speaker: Adrien
entries.raw: y'a bcp de boite rectangulaire aussi, c'est bien mais c'est juste un peu trop
entries.normalized_business_meaning: Reduce the number of rectangular cards/boxes.

entries.speaker: Adrien
entries.raw: et pour la police du site: Titres : Cormorant Garamond / Texte / navigation : Inter / titre: semibold , bold / texte / navigation: Regulier
entries.normalized_business_meaning: Typography: Cormorant Garamond for headings in semibold/bold; Inter Regular for text and navigation.

entries.speaker: Adrien
entries.raw: la page portfolio, tu peux la cacher pour l'instant / car j'ai pas encore des clients
entries.normalized_business_meaning: Do not expose Portfolio until client references exist.

entries.speaker: Adrien
entries.raw: avenzostudio.com a été déjà acheté par quelqu'un ... je vais utiliser avenzostudios.com / cest fait
entries.normalized_business_meaning: Use plural domain avenzostudios.com instead of unavailable avenzostudio.com.
entries.status: active; domain ownership/DNS not independently verified

entries.speaker: Adrien
entries.raw: i redefine the business not just between france and china but an agency to serve all clients
entries.normalized_business_meaning: Position the agency globally; France-China is not the whole business identity.

entries.speaker: Adrien
entries.raw: the problem with this one is there're no space, blank space, all so packed
entries.normalized_business_meaning: Increase whitespace and reduce visual density.

entries.speaker: Adrien
entries.raw: i like the interaction part u did with the version yesterday, you click you go to the detailed section / or relevant section
entries.normalized_business_meaning: Keep simple service-to-detail section navigation.

entries.speaker: Adrien
entries.raw: pour quoi le site n'a pas quatre page
entries.normalized_business_meaning: Public site must have four pages.

entries.speaker: Adrien
entries.raw: the version with interactives before mis à jour i like a lot, the pictures i send you are for the banners
entries.normalized_business_meaning: Preferred the earlier interactive version; supplied pictures are intended for banners.

entries.speaker: Adrien
entries.raw: la version de mardi
entries.normalized_business_meaning: Reference preference is the earlier Tuesday version.

entries.speaker: Adrien
entries.raw: la version simple tu clique il reviens sur la section correspondantes
entries.normalized_business_meaning: Keep interaction simple: click and land on the relevant section.

entries.speaker: Adrien
entries.raw: I like this one
entries.normalized_business_meaning: Approved the rebuilt Vercel direction.

entries.speaker: Adrien
entries.raw: Still some détails we could improve, thank you, i like it à lot the structure
entries.normalized_business_meaning: Keep the overall site structure while refining details.

entries.speaker: Adrien
entries.raw: un peu trop chargé
entries.normalized_business_meaning: The approved structure still needs lower visual density.

entries.speaker: Adrien
entries.raw: j'aime bien celui ci / il y a des trucs à changer mais j'aime bien celui ci
entries.normalized_business_meaning: Keep this structural direction rather than restarting from scratch.

entries.speaker: Adrien
entries.raw: merci beaucoup julian, c'est vraiment pas mal
entries.normalized_business_meaning: Positive validation of the then-current Vercel structure.

entries.speaker: Adrien
entries.raw: Titres : Cormorant Garamond / Texte / navigation : Inter / titre: semibold , bold / texte / navigation: Regulier
entries.normalized_business_meaning: Typography requirement reconfirmed.

entries.speaker: Adrien
entries.raw: les photos sont surpixelisé pas claire du tout
entries.normalized_business_meaning: The website images are visibly pixelated/overcompressed and not sharp enough. Image clarity must be improved without changing the approved layout.

entries.speaker: Julian relaying Adrien feedback
entries.raw: we dont put the good pictures he sent u on his website
entries.normalized_business_meaning: Adrien expects the four images he supplied to remain clearly visible in the website, especially the four homepage expertise entries. Generated imagery should complement, not displace, his selected visuals.
